# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.0 — 38 languages

Air Quality Advisor now covers **38 Home Assistant languages**, including 33 additions across Europe, Asia and the Middle East.

### Features
- More translated setup/Reconfigure labels, dashboard text and spoken/visual window recommendations.
- BCP47 locale variants, including Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified/Traditional Chinese.
- Right-to-left dashboard rendering for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu.
- Language choices for `air_quality_advisor.announce` and optional Announcement Hub/TTS delivery.
- Expanded translation completeness tests and frontend RTL checks.

### Compatibility
No migrations. Your sensors, configured rooms, exclusions, thresholds and dashboard remain unchanged.

TTS requires an installed provider and voice capable of speaking the selected language. The original five languages keep their full detailed help. New language packs provide translated core controls and concise guidance; rare validation errors fall back to English pending native review.

**Install:** Update Air Quality Advisor through HACS to v0.2.0, restart Home Assistant and refresh the dashboard. Full changes in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

This remains an advisory-only integration; it does not physically open/close windows.
